title: Scientific Target Selection
subtitle: Select a Mars observation target and establish a research objective.
description: Use Mission Control and Research Lab interfaces to review available Mars observation sites, examine operational constraints, select a scientific target, evaluate available datasets, and submit a justified observation proposal.

restrictions: Do not expose detailed Engineering system interfaces.
Do not expose detailed Habitat system interfaces.
Sol 3 must not automatically launch the drone.
Do not implement unrequested drone operations as mandatory Sol 3 tasks.

tasks.title: Review Mission Objectives and Outpost Status
tasks.objective: Review the scientific mission context, today's objectives, and the validated Sol 2 readiness assessment.

tasks.title: Explore Mars Observation Sites
tasks.objective: Inspect available observation-site information and compare candidates using their available metadata.
tasks.requiredTargetReferences: Every target catalogue entry must be referenced in the comparison record.

tasks.title: Review Communications and Operational Constraints
tasks.objective: Review available communication and system information that could affect observation planning.

tasks.title: Select a Proposed Scientific Target
tasks.objective: Choose or revise one proposed observation target and write a focused scientific question. The choice remains provisional until the final proposal is submitted and validated.
validationRules: The proposed target must exist in the available site catalogue.
Saving this task must not establish the official mission target.
The scientific question must be relevant to the selected target.
Supporting references must resolve to actual records.
Unknown site properties must not be invented.

tasks.title: Investigate and Select a Scientific Dataset
tasks.objective: Inspect available scientific datasets, review their metadata and provenance, and determine whether a dataset is suitable for the selected scientific question.
validationRules: The dataset must exist in the available catalogue.
The dataset must be relevant to the selected target and question.
Missing metadata must be labelled unavailable.
The player must not claim that a dataset proves a result beyond its capabilities.

tasks.title: Submit the Scientific Observation Proposal
tasks.objective: Review and submit the final scientific target proposal with its supporting site records, selected dataset, rationale and known limitations. A successful validated submission commits and locks its target as the official mission target for Sol 4.
validationRules: The selected target and dataset must exist.
The submitted target must match the saved provisional target selection.
Only this validated proposal submission establishes the official mission target.
After submission, the official target cannot be changed through the normal Sol 3 selection flow.
The question must be nonempty and relevant.
The proposal must not present a hypothesis as an established scientific result.
